businesses.business: Network and cybersecurity products and services

offering_description.value: Fortinet sells secure networking equipment, cybersecurity software, and cloud security services to businesses, service providers, and government agencies. It designs dedicated security processors for its appliances and delivers protection through physical appliances, virtual software, and cloud services.

primary_products.value: Network firewalls and secure routing appliances; Ethernet switches and wireless access points; cloud security and zero-trust access software; endpoint protection software; security analytics and automation software

primary_services.value: Threat intelligence and protection updates; cloud-delivered network security; managed detection and response; incident response; deployment consulting and training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Enterprises, small and midsize businesses, telecom carriers, and managed service providers; B2G: National, state, and local government agencies

end_markets.value: Enterprise IT; telecommunications; government; financial services; critical infrastructure

revenue_model.value: subscription: Threat protection updates, cloud security, and managed detection and response; product sales: Firewalls, secure routing appliances, switches, and wireless access points; licensing or royalties: Perpetual licenses for virtual firewall software; service fees: Deployment consulting, training, and incident response engagements
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Designs security processors and networking appliances, uses contract manufacturers, and sells through channel partners; software / platform: Develops software that uses network and endpoint telemetry to protect business and government systems; service provider: Uses threat intelligence and security analysts to monitor and respond to threats for organizations
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Secure networking, cloud security and access, endpoint protection, and security operations

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Authorized IT distributors supplying resellers and integrators; partners / resellers: Value-added resellers, systems integrators, telecom carriers, and managed security providers; direct sales: Sales teams serving major enterprise and government accounts, often alongside channel partners; online: Cloud marketplaces offering virtual appliances and subscriptions
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; partners / resellers; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Encryption exports face U.S. export controls, and cloud security data handling is subject to privacy laws including GDPR.
